notes: σήμερον takes *this day* whole, headed on *day*: the lexeme carries a day-element that *day* glosses, so rule 66's compound-core arm decides it and the deictic *this* answers to the modifying element. Heading it on *this* was rejected.
The second attributive τόν is unrepresented under rule 23, the first being emptied by *our* on ἡμῶν under rule 20.
